summary: Arterial south kerb with no parked cars and apartments within a few metres.
reasons: Busy road, no cars parked here

best_section.where: Sir Fred Schonell Drive south kerb at the Mitre Street corner

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 8 m at 14 m, then 2-4 m beyond; whole stretch is overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along a narrow verge, driveways and a bus stop; no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane arterial next to a signalled junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park on the north kerb but none along this south kerb.

sun_shade: Open to the sky; hedge and building shade from the south.
